name: Bowen W-Bot
summary: Bowen W-Bot is Yuequan Bionics’ wheeled humanoid manipulation robot. It combines a head and torso, two articulated arms and interchangeable dexterous hands with a compact mobile base and folding lower-body structure. This arrangement supports work close to the floor and at elevated positions. The robot has been demonstrated in the Faway–Yuequan application laboratory for automotive component tasks. It is a publicly released development platform; broad commercial delivery is unverified. This listing refers to the original W-Bot generation.
